🚀 JSSC JTMACCE 2025 Result: Out for 1373 Posts!
The Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) has released the official notification for the Jharkhand Trained Madhyamik Acharya Combined Competitive Examination 2025 (JTMACCE-2025) (Advt No. 02/2025), June 27, 2025. Online applications are now open for 1373 posts and will close on July 27, 2025, at 11:59 PM. Candidates can apply at the official website https://www.jssc.jharkhand.gov.in. Eligibility Criteria: Candidates must hold a Post-Graduate Degree with at least 55% marks or an Equivalent Grade, along with a 3-Years Integrated B.Ed./M.Ed./B.Sc.Ed., or a B.E./B.Tech (Computer Science/IT) with PGDCA, or an M.Sc. (Computer Science/IT), MCA, M.E., or M.Tech (Computer Science/IT). Age Limit (as of August 1, 2025): Minimum 21 years, Maximum 40 years (UR-Male), 42 years (EBC-I, BC-II-Male), 43 years (UR, EBC-I, BC-II-Female), 45 years (SC/ST-Male & Female), with age relaxation as per rules. Application Fee: Rs. 100 (General/EBC/BC/EWS), Rs. 50 (SC/ST of Jharkhand), payable via Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking. Selection Process: Based on Pre-exam and Mains exam. Pay Scale: Rs. 35,500-1,12,400 (Pay Level-6). Apply now and prepare for this exciting opportunity! #JSSC2025 #JTAMCCE
